handback.title: Wiki install page uses the thin workflow
handback.summary: The wiki's install page stops telling adopters to copy Dokima's workflows and code.
handback.user_story: Adopters following the wiki install page no longer copy Dokima's workflows and code into their repo.

acceptance_criteria.text: When an adopter reads the wiki install page, it never tells them to copy Dokima's workflows folder or code.
acceptance_criteria.words: docs/wiki/Installing.md stop telling adopters to copy `.github/workflows/` and `dokima/`
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A fixed page with no input; the test reads the whole page.

raises.label: Narrow story scope
raises.text: Should the page also drop Dokima's own two workflows and name the two files to add? The plan assumes no.
raises.evidence: The parent's approved story 4 has one criterion; its context names `playthrough.yml` and `wiki.yml`, which the page still lists.
